name: VBA
desc: An event-driven version of Visual Basic 6.0 built into most Microsoft Office apps for automation and scripting.

resources.name: Access Ribbon
resources.desc: An excellent resource for information for developing custom ribbon XML. Although principally targeted at Access, it is equally applicable to Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

resources.name: Planet Source Code
resources.desc: A code repository GitHub which holds copious amounts of code. The site was closed down in 2023, but fortunately all VBA/VB6 samples were archived on GitHub today. Possibly not the entire collection (?) of projects/source code that was previously available at the PSC website.

resources.name: Excel for Freelancers
resources.desc: Hands-on tutorials to developing specific applications from beginning through to end. All levels.

resources.name: Reddit
resources.desc: Daily VBA Q&A. Occasional Pro-Tip sharing and Show & Tell library publishing.

resources.name: Stack Overflow
resources.desc: A great place to ask questions. Duplicate questions are flagged as duplicates and send the author to the correct place.

resources.name: Visual Basic Discord
resources.desc: A chat room for VB.NET/VBA/VB6 fanatics.

resources.name: Excel Discord
resources.desc: Discord server moderated by Tim Heng (Excel MVP) with focus on helping Excel users.

resources.name: MrExcel
resources.desc: Mostly Excel generic, but a lot of VBA content can be found here also.

resources.name: VBForums - Office Development
resources.desc: Forum with focus on VB6/.NET with VBA section.
